prompt: Image 1 is a rough grey 3D blockout rendered from the exact camera position. Keep its geometry and perspective EXACTLY: a single-level hall with a flat ceiling, barred cell fronts on the left and right walls, and at the far end one wall with a wide barred opening into a larger chamber. Do not add a second floor, balconies, stairs, windows or extra doors, and do not move the walls or bars. Image 2 is only a STYLE reference for the look. Turn the blockout into a single frame of realistic helmet-mounted body camera footage: first person, wide-angle lens, low light, heavy digital noise, real colours, lit only by the harsh cone of the wearer's weapon flashlight. The death row block of an abandoned island penitentiary: damp cracked concrete, peeling grey-green paint, rusted steel bars, a drain grate in the floor, dust in the light beam. Behind the bars of the far chamber, small in the distance, a huge shaved-headed prisoner in a faded orange jumpsuit sits on a steel plate facing the camera. On the hall floor about halfway down lies one body in dark tactical gear. Small white monospace overlay text in the top left corner: 'COLE  CAM 05' and in the top right a red dot and 'REC 02:17:48'. Photorealistic found footage, no other people.
